title: Cross-lingual Functional Vectors for Emotion Detection in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.29613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Function vectors (FVs) have recently emerged as a promising mechanism for steering the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by injecting task-specific latent direction representations derived from in-context demonstrations. While prior studies have shown that FVs can recover task behavior in structured in-context learning settings, their effectiveness on semantically complex tasks and their ability to generalize across languages remain underexplored. We investigate the cross-lingual transferability of FVs using multilingual multi-label emotion recognition as a challenging semantic classification benchmark. Specifically, we examine whether FVs extracted from a source language can steer task behavior in another language under both standard clean and perturbed zero-shot settings without providing demonstrations during inference. translated_title: 大语言模型中用于情感检测的跨语言功能向量
translated_abstract: 功能向量（FVs）最近作为一种有前景的机制出现，它通过注入从上下文示例中提取的任务特定潜在方向表示来引导大语言模型（LLMs）的行为。虽然先前的研究表明功能向量可以在结构化的上下文学习设置中恢复任务行为，但其在语义复杂任务上的有效性以及跨语言泛化的能力仍未得到充分探索。我们以多语言多标签情感识别作为具有挑战性的语义分类基准，研究功能向量的跨语言可迁移性。具体而言，我们检验从源语言中提取的功能向量是否能够在标准干净和受扰动的零样本设置下，在推理时不提供示例的情况下引导另一种语言中的任务行为。在多样化的跨语言设置中，应用功能向量显著提升了性能，表明功能向量能够……
tldr: 该研究首次系统探索了功能向量（FVs）的跨语言可迁移性，证明从源语言提取的功能向量可以在零样本设置下有效引导大语言模型在其他语言（以多语言多标签情感识别为基准）上的任务行为，并带来显著的性能提升。
en_tdlr: This work systematically investigates the cross-lingual transferability of function vectors (FVs), demonstrating that FVs extracted from a source language can effectively steer LLM task behavior in other languages—using multilingual multi-label emotion recognition as a benchmark—under zero-shot settings with substantial performance gains.
